depictions.name: Kasuga Shrine
depictions.text: Kasuga Shrine (春日神社) was a Japanese shrine in Iga Province, Japan. It was nestled between the regions of Mibuno Vale and Otogi Pass. The Fujibayashi Clan Graveyard was located west of the shrine.
